title.narrative: Securing integrity, efficiency and independence of the justice system in Moldova - #Justice4Moldova

description.narrative:
Overall objective: to contribute to an increased role of civil society and media to support independence, integrity, efficiency, and accountability of the justice system in the Republic of Moldova.

Specific objectives:

  1. SO1: to enhance and strengthen civil society capacities to promote justice sector policies though policy development, monitoring and advocacy and increase their ability to interact with justice and anticorruption authorities and actors.
  2. SO2: to support joint efforts of civil society and media to assess the performance and governance of the justice sector, its institutions and stakeholders.
